name: Phantom Dragon
body:
School illusion (glamer); Level druid/shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a lizard’s eye)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 10 min./level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

With a touch, you cause a creature to appear as an adult dragon of a type of your choosing. If the target is already an adult dragon or older, you can make the target to appear one age category older than its current age.

You can attempt to make the target appear as a specific dragon; the target receives a +10 bonus to Disguise checks for this purpose. Direct interaction with the target allows creatures to make a Will save to see through the spell.
